headline: PPL (PPL) Could Be 14% Undervalued Following Reaffirmed 2026 Guidance
summary: Earnings snapshot and why PPL stock is in focus PPL (PPL) is back on investors’ radar after its second quarter 2026 earnings release and reaffirmed full year guidance, putting fresh financial detail around the utility’s recent share price performance. The company reported Q2 2026 sales of US$2.11b and net income of US$230m, with basic earnings per share from continuing operations of US$0.31.
